split: All 29 exact historical terrains with 2 exact it50 parent vs original tapes per terrain. Sort the sha256('cash-tree-split-v1/'+terrain); first 19 train, next 4 validation, last 6 test. Both seats/roles and all source tapes of a terrain share its assignment. 343 excluded. Date/geometries were seen during earlier historical development; local holdouts are segregated from BOTH current optimizations.
opportunities: Actual Master3s2 and actual it50-player opportunities both included. Bank t195-279, visible cargo>=40, distance own base 1-8; target realized own-worker largest normal deposit over next 20 steps, capped at 450 then /200; zero for uncredited including death. Tree t90-189, live planter not on enemy/own tree/base, nearby candidate soil public evidence or availability; label if worker pays for a safe rich actual site within next four decisions, then its first 25 steps' ground receipts minus fee, clipped +/-150 divided by 60, zero if no qualifying paid tree. Exact labels use only later referee events. Future data and opponent private observations do not enter model or eligibility.
selection: Uniform pre-outcome SHA rank of source/input identity. Maximum 16 roots per task/actor per tape. Require logged command legal in parent's actual release prefix and >=2 legal commands. Labels may be positive, negative or zero. Group comparisons within same task, coarse cargo or known carbon, distance or threat; eligible strata must contain two distinct physical-action-type choices plus realized positives and uncredited examples on other training maps. Fallback only to predeclared coarser state stratum if necessary. No single action is treated as counterfactual truth.
fit: One BC versus one ECON model, both same shuffled input order, same gradient-step count, same starting package. All trainable changes inside the existing Sapling worker action readout W and b; GRU/public latent, 75% it50, four-coefficient return guard and all other tensors remain frozen. Pure BC uses cross entropy+KL. ECON uses same loss plus signed matched standardized realized advantage multiplied by factual log-loss. Center expected returns across peers on OTHER training maps; equal-weight the two tasks, clip advantages +/-2.0. Eight passes, deterministic Adam lr .0025, KL coefficient .25, regularization squared .002. No checkpoint selection. Compare three released package entries on every held selected observation; separately report matching high and low outcome actions, parent/BC/ECON and prefix drift. No official examiner runs in this study.
